title: The Stranded Merchant
text: A merchant's wagon lies tilted in the road on a broken wheel while its owner sits on the steps, fanning himself. Fix it, he says, and he will pay well. The cargo under its tarp is lumpy and very still.

options.label: The strongest fixes the wheel without looking under the tarp.

outcomes.text: The merchant pays with a fine thing from the back. The tarp stays where it is.

options.label: The Leader buys from the cargo while he is desperate enough to bargain.

outcomes.text: For once the prices are fair. The tarp stays down.

options.label: Plunder the cargo; he cannot run on a broken wheel.

outcomes.text: It is a great deal of cargo, and word of it gets around.
